title: QA Engineer - Agentic Memory Testing
description:
We are looking for a QA Engineer to validate agent memory capabilities within an enterprise AI Agent Platform being built from the ground up. The role will focus on ensuring that AI agents reliably retain, retrieve, and manage contextual information across both individual conversations and multiple sessions. You will test stateful and personalized agent behaviors , memory extraction and retrieval, lifecycle controls, and regression scenarios to ensure that memory improves agent performance without introducing incorrect or irrelevant context. What project we have for you About the Client Our client is a large global enterprise operating across multiple markets, with a complex technology landscape and a strong focus on digital transformation and innovation. The organization is actively investing in modern cloud, data, and AI capabilities to enable scalable, secure, and highly automated solutions across its business. About the Project The project is focused on building an enterprise-grade AI Agent Platform from the ground up. The platform will provide a standardized foundation for developing, deploying, orchestrating, securing, and observing AI agents across multiple teams and use cases. The initiative covers the full agent lifecycle and brings together agent orchestration, observability, security, governance, integrations, evaluation, and platform engineering. Engineers joining the project will have an opportunity to influence key architectural and technical decisions and contribute to a new platform rather than maintaining an existing solution. What you will do Design and execute functional tests for short-term and long-term agent memory . Validate in-session context continuity and cross-session memory recall . Test memory extraction strategies to ensure that summaries, facts, and preferences are captured correctly . Validate memory retrieval to ensure agents retrieve relevant context while filtering irrelevant information . Test memory lifecycle behaviors , including TTL expiration, deletion, and namespace isolation. Develop Python-based automated tests for agent memory workflows and API-driven services. Perform regression testing to ensure memory changes do not negatively affect agent response quality. Validate stateful agent behaviors including context retention and personalization . Test memory isolation to prevent inappropriate context sharing between users, sessions, or agents. Validate user deletion and privacy-related memory workflows . Integrate memory testing into broader agent quality and regression suites . Collaborate with AI and platform engineers to identify memory-related defects and improve agent reliability. What you need for this Skills: - Agent memory functional testing - short-term memory (in-session continuity), long-term memory (cross-session recall) - Memory extraction validation - verify Summary and Semantic strategies extract correct facts/preferences - Memory retrieval testing - validate agents retrieve relevant context, filter irrelevant memories - Memory lifecycle testing - TTL expiration, user deletion, namespace isolation - Agent regression testing - verify memory does not degrade agent response quality - Python test automation for memory workflows Experience: - 4+ years QA engineering for AI/ML or conversational AI systems - Testing stateful agent behaviors (context retention, personalization) - Functional test automation for API-driven services - Regression testing methodologies Nice to have: - Agent memory framework testing (LangChain, LangGraph) - Conversational AI evaluation - AWS AgentCore Memory testing - GDPR compliance testing (user deletion validation) What it s like to work at Intellias At Intellias, where technology takes center stage, people always come before processes. By creating a comfortable atmosphere in our team, we empower individuals to unlock their true potential and achieve extraordinary results. That s why we offer a range of benefits that support your well-being and charge your professional growth.
We are committed to fostering equity, diversity, and inclusion as an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without discrimination based on race, color, religion, age, gender, nationality, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.
We welcome and celebrate the uniqueness of every individual. Join Intellias for a career where your perspectives and contributions are vital to our shared success.

title: Junior QA Engineer / Technology Associate
description:
About the Role 
 We are looking for a fully remote (you can be located anywhere) Junior QA Engineer / Technology Associate to join our technology team. This is an entry-level position suitable for a recent graduate or someone with up to two years of experience who wants to build a career in software technology. 
 The role will initially focus on software quality assurance and hands-on testing of web applications, with opportunities to develop additional technical skills and responsibilities over time. 
 Role & Responsibilities Perform manual functional, regression, integration, and browser-based testing of web applications. Create, maintain, and execute test cases and testing scenarios. Test application workflows, business rules, calculations, inputs, and outputs. Identify, reproduce, document, and track software defects. Retest fixes and perform regression testing as applications are updated. Work closely with developers and other team members to communicate issues and verify resolutions. Assist with API testing and data validation where appropriate. Help maintain QA documentation and testing records. Work alongside experienced team members as we expand our automated testing and regression-testing capabilities. Preferred Candidate Profile B.Tech/B.E., BCA, B.Sc. Computer Science/IT, MCA, or similar technical education. 02 years of experience; fresh graduates are encouraged to apply. Basic understanding of software development and software testing concepts. Strong analytical and problem-solving ability. Excellent attention to detail and a systematic approach to testing. Good written and verbal English communication skills. Ability to learn new technologies independently and work effectively with a distributed technology team. Exposure to manual testing, APIs, SQL, Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, Git/GitHub, or other software technologies through coursework, projects, internships, or employment is helpful but not required. 
 Growth Opportunity 
 This position is designed for someone who wants to develop broader technical capabilities over time. Based on aptitude, performance, and interest, there may be opportunities to gain hands-on experience in areas such as QA automation, API testing, SQL and data validation, CI/CD, cloud technologies, Salesforce integrations, and AI-enabled software applications. 
 We value people who are curious about how software works, enjoy investigating problems, love team culture and are motivated to continually expand their technical skills.
